history.overview: The Refinery processes Discord‑tainted ore and arcane slag into usable industrial materials.

timeline.name: Ore Extraction
timeline.description: Muramite miners extracted Discord‑tainted ore from fissures.

timeline.name: Refinery Construction
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves built furnaces, vats, and conveyor lines.

timeline.name: Arcane Purification
timeline.description: Inquisitors developed purification methods for arcane slag.

timeline.name: Industrial Integration
timeline.description: Refined materials were routed to the Foundry and Reactor.
